papers.title: Automatic Generation of Probabilistic Programming from Time Series Data
papers.abstract: Probabilistic programming languages represent complex data with intermingled models in a few lines of code. Efficient inference algorithms in probabilistic programming languages make possible to build unified frameworks to compute interesting probabilities of various large, real-world problems. When the structure of model is given, constructing a probabilistic program is rather straightforward. Thus, main focus have been to learn the best model parameters and compute marginal probabilities. In this paper, we provide a new perspective to build expressive probabilistic program from continue time series data when the structure of model is not given. The intuition behind of our method is to find a descriptive covariance structure of time series data in nonparametric Gaussian process regression. We report that such descriptive covariance structure efficiently derives a probabilistic programming description accurately.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于时间序列数据的概率程序自动生成，与FEA替代模型、植入物设计或生物力学无关。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA, no surrogate modeling, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling or UQ for surrogate applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 从连续时间序列数据自动生成概率程序
summary_zh.method: 利用非参数高斯过程回归的协方差结构推导程序
summary_zh.result: 能准确描述数据的概率编程模型

summary_en.motivation: To automatically generate a probabilistic program from continuous time series data when the model structure is unknown.
summary_en.method: Exploit the descriptive covariance structure learned via nonparametric Gaussian process regression to derive the program.
summary_en.result: The derived covariance structure accurately yields a probabilistic program representation.

papers.title: Improved mechanical properties of the new Ti-15Ta-xZr alloys fabricated by selective laser melting for biomedical application
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Digital Media and Design, Hangzhou Dianzi University, Hangzhou, 310018, China

corresponding_authors.name: Youwei Yuan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Computer Science and Technology, Hangzhou Dianzi University, Hangzhou, 310018, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及SLM制备新型钛合金用于生物医学，但未涉及应力遮挡、多孔结构或疲劳性能等核心方向。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure design, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发新型Ti-15Ta-xZr合金以满足生物医用植入材料的力学性能需求。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化技术制备不同Zr含量的Ti-15Ta-xZr合金。
summary_zh.result: 通过调整Zr含量，合金的强度和塑性得到显著改善。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和显微组织观察验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a new Ti-15Ta-xZr alloy with enhanced mechanical properties for biomedical implant applications.
summary_en.method: Ti-15Ta-xZr alloys with varying Zr content were fabricated using selective laser melting (SLM).
summary_en.result: The addition of Zr improved both strength and ductility of the alloy, with optimal composition achieving balanced mechanical performance.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through tensile testing and microstructural characterization.
